Our services

Complete veterinary care for your pet

From routine wellness to advanced veterinary intervention care — one team, one hospital, for every stage of your pet's life.

Primary Care

Routine exams and wellness care for dogs and cats — the foundation of your pet's health, from first visit to senior years.

Advanced Diagnostics

CT scan, echocardiogram and tracheal stent — advanced diagnostics that find the answer when an exam alone can't.

Surgical Care

Surgical care from an experienced veterinary team, with clear guidance before and after the procedure.

Puppy & Kitten Care

First exams, vaccinations and guidance for new puppies and kittens — a healthy start for the newest member of your family.

Hospice & End-of-Life Care

Hospice counseling and compassionate end-of-life care, with honest guidance for the hardest decisions a pet owner faces.

Pet Travel

Planning a trip with your pet? We help with travel health requirements and paperwork for pets on the move.

About our hospital

A friendly team, guiding your pet’s care

We are located in Monterey Park, near the 60 freeway on Atlantic Blvd. Our friendly veterinary care team will guide you for the healthcare needs of your pet — including exotic pet care and advanced veterinary intervention care when your pet needs more than a routine visit.

  • Primary care — routine exams and wellness care for dogs and cats.
  • Advanced diagnostics — CT scan, echocardiogram and tracheal stent.
  • Surgical care — from routine procedures to advanced intervention.
  • Exotic pet care — veterinary care for exotic pets, not just dogs and cats.
Your visit

What to expect at your appointment

1

Book an appointment

Call us and tell us about your pet. We'll find a time that works — same-day when we can.

2

Exam & consultation

Our friendly veterinary care team examines your pet and talks through what they find, in plain language.

3

Diagnosis & treatment plan

If tests or treatment are needed, we explain the options and agree the plan with you — including advanced diagnostics when it helps.
